description: AlphaFold structural analysis of zebrafish accs: pLDDT profile, position of Cys302 relative to the PLP lysine K274, and packing of the C-terminal extension
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
os.makedirs('/tmp/af',exist_ok=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

for acc,lab in [('A0A8M1N4R4','DANRE_accs'),('Q96QU6','HUMAN_ACCS')]:
    r=requests.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb',timeout=120)
    open(f'/tmp/af/{lab}.pdb','w').write(r.text); print(lab,r.status_code,len(r.text))

def read_pdb(p):
    rows=[]
    for L in open(p):
        if L.startswith('ATOM'):
            rows.append((L[12:16].strip(),L[17:20].strip(),int(L[22:26]),
                         float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54]),float(L[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['name','resn','resi','x','y','z','b'])

Z=read_pdb('/tmp/af/DANRE_accs.pdb')
ca=Z[Z.name=='CA'].set_index('resi')
pl=ca.b
print('\nzebrafish accs AF model: %d residues, mean pLDDT %.1f'%(len(pl),pl.mean()))
segs=[(1,30,'N-term'),(31,452,'PLP core (aligns to hACCS 1-501)'),(453,556,'C-terminal extension')]
for lo,hi,lab in segs:
    s=pl.loc[lo:hi]; print(f'  {lab:36s} {lo:3d}-{hi:3d}  mean pLDDT {s.mean():5.1f}  %>70 {100*(s>70).mean():5.1f}  %<50 {100*(s<50).mean():5.1f}')

# distances from zebrafish PLP lysine K274 NZ
def atom(df,resi,name):
    s=df[(df.resi==resi)&(df.name==name)]
    return s[['x','y','z']].values[0] if len(s) else None
K=atom(Z,274,'NZ'); print('\nK274 resn =', Z[Z.resi==274].resn.iloc[0])
key={302:'CA',408:'CA',152:'CA',237:'CA',282:'CA',146:'CA',83:'CA',86:'CA',209:'CA'}
print('distance from K274 NZ (active-site anchor):')
for r_,at in key.items():
    v=atom(Z,r_,at); 
    print(f'   {Z[Z.resi==r_].resn.iloc[0]}{r_:4d} CA  {np.linalg.norm(v-K):6.2f} A   pLDDT {ca.b[r_]:.1f}')
# C302 SG specifically
sg=atom(Z,302,'SG'); print(f'   C302 SG      {np.linalg.norm(sg-K):6.2f} A')

# Does the C-terminal extension (453-556) contact the active site?
core_at=Z[(Z.resi>=31)&(Z.resi<=452)][['x','y','z']].values
ext=Z[Z.resi>=453]
d_to_K=np.linalg.norm(ext[['x','y','z']].values-K,axis=1)
print('\nC-terminal extension (453-556): min distance of any atom to K274 NZ = %.1f A'%d_to_K.min())
print('  residue closest to active site:', ext.iloc[d_to_K.argmin()][['resn','resi','name']].to_dict())
# buried contacts between extension and core
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
t=cKDTree(core_at)
cnt=t.query_ball_point(ext[['x','y','z']].values, r=5.0)
ncontact=sum(len(c)>0 for c in cnt)
print('  extension atoms within 5 A of core (31-452): %d / %d (%.1f%%)'%(ncontact,len(ext),100*ncontact/len(ext)))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(pl.index,pl.values,lw=0.9,color='#2b6cb0')
ax.axhspan(0,50,color='#e53e3e',alpha=.08); ax.axhspan(50,70,color='#dd6b20',alpha=.08); ax.axhspan(70,90,color='#38a169',alpha=.06)
ax.axvspan(453,556,color='#805ad5',alpha=.13,label='C-terminal extension (453-556)')
for r_,c in [(274,'k'),(302,'#c53030'),(408,'#2f855a')]:
    ax.axvline(r_,color=c,ls='--',lw=1.2)
    ax.text(r_,103,f'{Z[Z.resi==r_].resn.iloc[0]}{r_}',rotation=90,fontsize=8,ha='center',va='bottom',color=c)
ax.set_xlabel('zebrafish accs residue (A0A8M1N4R4)'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,115)
ax.legend(loc='lower left',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence for zebrafish accs: the 104-residue C-terminal extension is low confidence',fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
dd=np.linalg.norm(Z[['x','y','z']].values-K,axis=1)
perres=pd.DataFrame({'resi':Z.resi,'d':dd}).groupby('resi').d.min()
ax.plot(perres.index,perres.values,lw=0.8,color='#4a5568')
ax.axvspan(453,556,color='#805ad5',alpha=.13)
ax.axhline(10,color='#c53030',ls=':',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('min dist to\nK274 NZ (A)'); ax.set_ylim(0,60)
ax.set_title('Distance of every residue to the PLP lysine K274',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
